detail: cfg_scale=7 alone (without --hq) adopted composite 58.5 vs cfg=5 baseline of 56.0. BUT superseded: cfg=5+hq=true reaches 62.98 — --hq is the real lever. With hq on, cfg=5 is optimal (cfg=7+hq not tested but cfg=5+hq wins on available data).
audio_cfg_scale=3.0 consistently regresses voice_score vs default (5.0). Confirmed dead-end across multiple sweeps — do not retry.

LTX-2.3 dasiwa audio naturalness ceiling ~60-65% composite (ASR/WER already 100%/0). Audio-knob sweeps (cfg-scale, stage1-only) cannot break this ceiling. Next lever is speech-gate multiplier av_ca in vendor_patches.py (currently 1000.0). After hq=true, weakest is now voice.snr=4.8 dB.

stage1_steps=20, stage1_steps=25, and stage2_steps=5 all regress composite vs default (15/3 with --hq). Default step counts are superior for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. With --hq, stage1_steps defaults to 15 (res_2s sampler) which is proven effective — do not override to 20 or 25.

LTX-2.3 dasiwa BEST confirmed config (2026-06-20 run 20260620_120410): cfg_scale=5, stg_scale=1.0, hq=true, stage1_steps=15 (res_2s), stage2=3, modality_scale=5, seed=42, composite=63.93. Prior best was 62.98 (no modality_scale override). 25 frames sufficient for quality judgment.

--hq (TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline, res_2s second-order Runge-Kutta sampler) is the primary quality lever for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Raises composite 58.5→62.98 (+4.5) at cfg=5+stage1=15. Fixes quality.edge (was 17-31, now not weakest). New weakest: voice.snr=4.8 dB. --hq is now dasiwa CLI default. Not compatible with --distilled.

modality_scale=2 regresses composite to 59.96 vs 63.93 at modality_scale=5 for dasiwa/LTX-2.3. Tried twice in run 20260620_120410 (iterations 1 and 4), both showed the same regression. Do not retry modality_scale=2.
